verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents a Marketing API for campaigns, including a separate send action, which implies campaigns exist in an unsent state before an explicit send. It also advertises creating campaigns from the AI chat a user already uses. Neither item shows that an agent can target a segment or leave a campaign scheduled or queued for human sign-off. missing for 10: documented campaign draft/create endpoint with segment targeting, documented schedule or queued state for API-created campaigns, an explicit human approval/review workflow before send, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven drafting.
